arthur_baker00: By the time Clement Baker reached P-F11, the war was 10 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Clement Baker and Roland Serreno tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
ba_roman98: The sergeant gave Silas "Tin" Roman a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Silas "Tin" Roman helped stack spare sandbags at T-F3. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Silas "Tin" Roman (Concord) and Zeno Helldiver (Hegemony) ended up in the same shell hole at Grey Mill. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
dax_j_king: The draft reached R-F2 on Day 4. Dietrich "Tin" King was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
Rain all night. Dietrich "Tin" King bailed water out of R-F2 with a helmet until his hands stopped feeling anything.

Dietrich "Tin" King took a wrong turn at two identical trench junctions. He decided the route needed names that could be remembered under pressure. Dietrich "Tin" King walked the captured trenches of Hill 304 and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Dietrich "Tin" King marked the first junction with a spoon and the second with a boot sole. Other runners have begun using the names in their directions.
Dietrich "Tin" King borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
The last of the jam was shared by scraping it onto a biscuit. Dietrich "Tin" King approved the method.
Someone removed the spoon from Dietrich "Tin" King's junction to eat supper. He retrieved it and nailed it above comfortable reaching height.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Dietrich "Tin" King did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

A round went through the rim of Dietrich "Tin" King's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Pavel Rvmn of the Concord (@____rvmn). The clerk counted the names twice. Dietrich "Tin" King is number 289 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand.
emory.mod: Marek "Smokes" Mod arrived on Day 6 as a replacement. The men in R-S7 had been fighting for 5 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
Marek "Smokes" Mod measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
Marek "Smokes" Mod and Clement Breadcrumb carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
A muddy dog crawled into R-S7 through the wire. Marek "Smokes" Mod gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Kaiser.
Kaiser has learned to carry messages in a tin on its collar. Marek "Smokes" Mod is very proud. Kaiser is mainly proud of the biscuits.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-S7 with the rations. Marek "Smokes" Mod ate while listening to the revised orders.

A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Marek "Smokes" Mod gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Marek "Smokes" Mod is number 424. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
halfire87: Day 10. The corporal put Valentin Halfire beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Someone asked Valentin Halfire to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
iago_curi: Lucien Curi introduced himself as a coal miner from Tannenfeld. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.

Lucien Curi found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. Mail came up the line with a letter for Lucien Curi. Lucien Curi read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
m0nster_boi: Otto Boi stepped off the supply cart at S-C14 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Otto Boi helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Otto Boi carried hot tea up to the front line in petrol cans. Everyone could taste the petrol. Everyone drank it. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Otto Boi answered to number 966.
maxhuntertattoos: Dorian Maxhuntertat arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a cracked shaving mirror and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Konrad "Crow" Dinhdong (Hegemony) and Dorian Maxhuntertat (Concord) spotted the same abandoned cart near Sorrow Copse. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was. The snipers took Dorian Maxhuntertat in on a busy morning in S-S4. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Dorian Maxhuntertat fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Otto "Parson" Vicious, now badly wounded. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Dorian Maxhuntertat helped stack spare sandbags at S-S4. Nobody asked when they would be needed. A letter from home found Dorian Maxhuntertat before the night shift. Dorian Maxhuntertat folded it small and kept it close.

The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Dorian Maxhuntertat ate two helpings anyway. Dorian Maxhuntertat got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 523. The men who came later will ask about it.
oreo_boi_5000: Ivo Boi signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-F3 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Ivo Boi ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.

Quentin Souptime (Hegemony) and Ivo Boi (Concord) spotted the same abandoned cart near the Drowned Farm. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was. After the loss of Hill 304, Ivo Boi helped stack spare sandbags at S-F3. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt (Hegemony) and Ivo Boi (Concord) ended up in the same shell hole at Verdel Ridge. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
The patrol came back one man at a time. Ivo Boi held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone.

A round came through the loophole Ivo Boi was watching at S-F3 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer of the Hegemony (@w0lfer2210). Ivo Boi was killed outright at S-F3, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer of the Hegemony (@w0lfer2210).
Lucien Boi joined S-F3 under the shadow of Ivo Boi's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Lucien Boi caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-F3 with the rations. Lucien Boi ate while listening to the revised orders.

Lucien Boi learned that the colonel's ham is stored in the cellar at battalion headquarters. He has been making careful drawings. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Lucien Boi is number 292. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
rmr7015: Dietrich Rmr came up the line with a book with the last pages torn out and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Dietrich Rmr helped stack spare sandbags at T-F17. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Dietrich Rmr saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Isidor "Spark" Hand, grazed.
some_random_helldiver: Day 4: Rafael Helldiver reached R-F1 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Rafael Helldiver watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been. A letter from home found Rafael Helldiver before the night shift. Rafael Helldiver folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet found Rafael Helldiver at R-F1, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. A letter from home found Rafael Helldiver before the night shift. Rafael Helldiver folded it small and kept it close. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Rafael Helldiver watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Rafael Helldiver died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
A letter came with Zeno Helldiver: "I am Rafael Helldiver's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

A pump handle snapped off in Zeno Helldiver's hands. He fixed it while the water rose around his ankles. Zeno Helldiver transferred to the stretcher bearers. The men in R-F1 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Zeno Helldiver asked to see the second one. The barber laughed. A letter from home found Zeno Helldiver before the night shift. Zeno Helldiver folded it small and kept it close.

Zeno Helldiver offered a spare button for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. A letter from home found Zeno Helldiver before the night shift. Zeno Helldiver folded it small and kept it close.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Zeno Helldiver was hit hard in the fight at R-F1 before anyone could fire. The raider was Dietrich Ripvanwinkle of the Concord. Raider: Dietrich Ripvanwinkle of the Concord (@ripvanwinkle3031). No rifles, only shovels and knives. Zeno Helldiver dropped into the Concord trench by a dugout door and met Dorian Joebandilla coming out. It was over in seconds. (@joebandilla) The flare went up just as Zeno Helldiver reached the Concord parapet. Zeno Helldiver jumped down first. Pavel "Parson" Collins was the man waiting there, and Pavel "Parson" Collins fell. (@forgettable_collins) The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Zeno Helldiver did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again. A letter from home found Zeno Helldiver before the night shift. Zeno Helldiver folded it small and kept it close.

Back on the fire step at R-F1. Zeno Helldiver says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign. A letter from home found Zeno Helldiver before the night shift. Zeno Helldiver folded it small and kept it close. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Zeno Helldiver is number 316. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
tylerjohnlaster: By the time Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas reached S-S8, the war was 5 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas ate two helpings anyway. The chaplains took Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas in on a busy morning in S-S8. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt had Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas of the Concord in the sights at Hill 304 for a long second. Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas was lighting a pipe. Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt let the match burn all the way down. A letter from home found Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas before the night shift. Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas folded it small and kept it close.

Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection. A letter from home found Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas before the night shift. Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas folded it small and kept it close.

Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas dreamt he was back in Saint-Lune, working as a fisherman. He woke up and said nothing all morning. A letter from home found Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas before the night shift. Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas folded it small and kept it close.

Night raid. Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas. Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas wrote down the news without trying to explain it. A letter from home found Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas before the night shift. Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas folded it small and kept it close.

Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas held a service in a shell hole. Eleven men came. Two of them had never prayed before. Both of them asked for another. The clerk counted the names twice. Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas is number 377 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand.
vandahinten: Gustav Vandahinten arrived on Day 10 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

Gustav Vandahinten was hit in the foot through his boot at P-F15. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Otto Lopez of the Concord (@manny_lopez.18). The bearers reached Gustav Vandahinten at P-F15 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Otto Lopez of the Concord (@manny_lopez.18).

The House of Vandahinten sent Tobias Vandahinten after Gustav Vandahinten. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. Tobias Vandahinten left the work of a sniper to become a rifleman. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.
waylon_h29: Isidor Waylon reported to S-R16 with a photograph gone soft at the edges sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Isidor Waylon watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

The order named Isidor Waylon as Lance Corporal. He read it twice, then asked who would take over his watch. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Isidor Waylon is number 964. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
yaboypolarbear: Teodor Yaboypolarbe came from Rosenau, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Number 89 on the early rolls: Teodor Yaboypolarbe. The First Wave ribbon arrived with instructions about where to sew it and no needle.
Teodor Yaboypolarbe got a letter from Ilse. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.

Teodor Yaboypolarbe wrote back to Ilse and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Teodor Yaboypolarbe let himself talk about leave for the first time in days. Orders assigned Teodor Yaboypolarbe to work as a rifleman. The first lesson began with what not to touch. Teodor Yaboypolarbe became a signaller today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.
A parcel from home held a comb. Teodor Yaboypolarbe has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
A bucket appeared above the Hegemony parapet at the Hanging Bridge. Teodor Yaboypolarbe fired. Gideon Bao pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'

Teodor Yaboypolarbe spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. A letter from home found Teodor Yaboypolarbe before the night shift. Teodor Yaboypolarbe folded it small and kept it close. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Teodor Yaboypolarbe read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Teodor Yaboypolarbe got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces. A letter from home found Teodor Yaboypolarbe before the night shift. Teodor Yaboypolarbe folded it small and kept it close.

A newspaper reached Teodor Yaboypolarbe with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well. A letter from home found Teodor Yaboypolarbe before the night shift. Teodor Yaboypolarbe folded it small and kept it close.

The corporal found out Teodor Yaboypolarbe used to be a tram conductor. Teodor Yaboypolarbe has been doing two jobs ever since. A letter from home found Teodor Yaboypolarbe before the night shift. Teodor Yaboypolarbe folded it small and kept it close.
Teodor Yaboypolarbe of the Concord spotted Emil Galvanooooo of the Hegemony repairing a parapet at the Ossuary Wood. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.

The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-F14, Teodor Yaboypolarbe listened to three explanations and trusted none of them. A letter from home found Teodor Yaboypolarbe before the night shift. Teodor Yaboypolarbe folded it small and kept it close.

A parcel came for Teodor Yaboypolarbe that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: two knitted scarves. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping. A letter from home found Teodor Yaboypolarbe before the night shift. Teodor Yaboypolarbe folded it small and kept it close.
